bubbles.title: Demo story
bubbles.hint: shell opens, prompt entered -> rough track sketched; user classifies/fills fog; fork at one bubble, diverge at another; move two bubbles; remove a useless one; park further ideas as new tracks; handoff on context fill; tracks list; switch to another track (progress list + active bubble); finish that simple track; peek at .bubbles/*.json to show links + state. Written up in demo/story.md

bubbles.title: Diverge title
bubbles.hint: diverge [N] <name> [title]: optional title for the side track (default: the bubble's title); help, SKILL.md, README, test; story uses it

bubbles.title: Browser CLI build
bubbles.hint: done: site/bubble-web.js runs the committed CLI JS unchanged (fake fs/path/process); site/build.js packs it verbatim into _site/cli-sources.js (npm run site); test/web.test.js replays every bubble line of demo/story.md on both and diffs output + disk

bubbles.title: Pages terminal
bubbles.hint: GitHub Pages static site (docs/ or similar): emulated terminal running the real browser CLI build; plays the story, then lets the visitor type

bubbles.title: Site in TypeScript
bubbles.hint: site/ to TS (.mts -> ESM .mjs) in standalone folders: site/bubble-web (CLI in a browser, no DOM types), site/terminal (the page), site/build (assemble _site); one tsconfig each; data as JSON; tests compile with tsc
